articles.title_en: Polity Size and Local Government Performance: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 政体规模与地方政府绩效：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: Developing countries have increasingly decentralized power to local governments. This paper studies the implications of a central element of decentralization (polity size) using population-based discontinuities that determine local government boundaries for over 100,000 Indian villages. Over the short and long run, individuals allocated into local governments with smaller populations have better access to public goods. We provide suggestive evidence that these results are related to heightened civic engagement and stronger political incentives, but not to other mechanisms such as elite capture. (JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, O17, O18, R50)
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家越来越多地将权力下放给地方政府。本文利用基于人口的不连续性来研究分权的一个核心要素（政体规模）的影响，这些不连续性决定了超过100,000个印度村庄的地方政府边界。在短期和长期内，被分配到人口较少的地方政府的个人能更好地获得公共物品。我们提供的提示性证据表明，这些结果与公民参与度提高和政治激励增强有关，但与其他机制如精英俘获无关。（JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, O17, O18, R50）

articles.abstract_en: We propose a theory of gradualism in the implementation of good policies, suitable for environments featuring time consistency. We downplay the role of the initial period by allowing agents both to wait for future agents to start equilibrium play and to restart the equilibrium by ignoring past history. The allocation gradually transits toward one that weighs both short- and long-term concerns, stopping short of the Ramsey outcome but greatly improving upon Markovian equilibria. We use the theory to account for the slow emergence of both climate policies and the reduction of global tariff rates. (JEL C73, E21, E61, F13, H30)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个在良好政策实施中渐进主义的理论，适用于具有时间一致性的环境。我们通过允许代理人等待未来代理人开始均衡博弈，以及通过忽略过去历史来重新启动均衡，从而淡化了初始时期的作用。配置逐渐过渡到同时权衡短期和长期关注的配置，虽未达到拉姆齐结果，但大大改善了马尔可夫均衡。我们利用该理论来解释气候政策和全球关税税率下降的缓慢出现。（JEL C73, E21, E61, F13, H30）

articles.title_en: Generalized Social Marginal Welfare Weights Imply Inconsistent Comparisons of Tax Policies
articles.title_cn: 广义社会边际福利权重意味着税收政策的比较不一致
articles.abstract_en: This paper concerns Saez and Stantcheva’s (2016) generalized social marginal welfare weights, which aggregate losses and gains due to tax policies while incorporating nonutilitarian ethical considerations. The approach evaluates local tax changes without a global social objective. I show that local tax policy comparisons implicitly entail global comparisons. Moreover, whenever welfare weights do not have a utilitarian structure, these implied global comparisons are inconsistent. I argue that broader ethical values cannot in general be represented simply by modifying the weights placed on benefits to different people, and a more thoroughgoing modification of the utilitarian approach is required. (JEL D60, D63, D71, H21, H23, I31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文关注Saez和Stantcheva（2016）提出的广义社会边际福利权重，该权重在纳入非功利主义伦理考量的同时，汇总税收政策带来的损失和收益。该方法在没有全局社会目标的情况下评估局部税收变化。我表明，局部税收政策比较隐含地涉及全局比较。此外，只要福利权重不具有功利主义结构，这些隐含的全局比较就是不一致的。我认为，更广泛的伦理价值观通常不能简单地通过修改赋予不同人收益的权重来代表，而需要对功利主义方法进行更彻底的修改。（JEL D60, D63, D71, H21, H23, I31）

articles.title_en: The Dynamic Consequences of State Building: Evidence from the French Revolution
articles.title_cn: 国家建设的动态后果：来自法国大革命的证据
articles.abstract_en: How do radical reforms shape economic development over time? In 1790, the French Constituent Assembly overhauled the kingdom’s organization to establish new local capitals. In some departments, the choice of local capitals over rival candidate cities was plausibly exogenous. We study how changes in administrative presence affect state capacity and development in the ensuing decades. In the short run, administrative proximity increases taxation and investments in law enforcement. In the long run, capitals obtain more public goods and grow faster. Our results shed light on the dynamic impacts of state building following one of history’s most ambitious administrative reforms. (JEL D70, H41, H71, O18, O43)
articles.abstract_cn: 激进改革如何长期塑造经济发展？在1790年，法国制宪议会彻底改革了王国的组织，以建立新的地方首府。在某些省份，地方首府的选择相对于竞争候选城市而言似乎是外生的。我们研究行政存在的改变如何影响随后几十年的国家能力和发展。在短期内，行政邻近性增加了税收和执法投资。在长期内，首府获得更多公共物品并增长更快。我们的结果揭示了历史上最雄心勃勃的行政改革之一后国家建设的动态影响。（JEL D70, H41, H71, O18, O43）

articles.title_en: Merchants of Death: The Effect of Credit Supply Shocks on Hospital Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 死亡商人：信贷供给冲击对医院结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the link between credit supply and hospital health outcomes. We use bank stress tests as exogenous shocks to credit access for hospitals that have lending relationships with tested banks. We find that affected hospitals shift their operations to increase resource utilization following a negative credit shock but reduce the quality of their care to patients across a variety of measures, including a significant increase in risk-adjusted readmission and mortality rates. The results indicate that access to credit can affect the quality of health care hospitals deliver, pointing to important spillover effects of credit market frictions on health outcomes. (JEL G21, G32, I11, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了信贷供给与医院健康结局之间的联系。我们利用银行压力测试作为对与受测银行有贷款关系的医院信贷准入的外生冲击。我们发现，受影响的医院在负面信贷冲击后调整其运营以提高资源利用率，但降低了其对患者护理的质量，体现在多种指标上，包括风险调整后再入院率和死亡率的显著增加。结果表明，信贷准入可以影响医院提供的医疗服务质量，指出信贷市场摩擦对健康结局的重要溢出效应。（JEL G21, G32, I11, I18）

articles.title_cn: 微观风险与（稳健的）帕累托改进政策
articles.abstract_en: We provide conditions for the feasibility of robust Pareto-improving (RPI) policies when markets are incomplete and the interest rate is below the growth rate. We allow for arbitrary heterogeneity in preferences and income risk and a wedge between the return to capital and bonds. An RPI improves risk sharing and can induce a more efficient level of capital. Elasticities of aggregate savings to changes in interest rates are the crucial ingredients to the feasibility of RPIs. Government debt may complement rather than substitute for capital in an RPI. Our analysis emphasizes the welfare-improving qualities of government bonds versus explicit redistribution. (JEL D52, E43, E62, H20, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在市场不完全且利率低于增长率时，稳健帕累托改进（RPI）政策可行性的条件。我们允许偏好和收入风险存在任意异质性，以及资本回报与债券之间存在楔子。RPI改善了风险分担，并能引致更有效的资本水平。总储蓄对利率变化的弹性是RPI可行性的关键因素。在RPI中，政府债务可能补充而非替代资本。我们的分析强调了政府债券相对于显性再分配的福利改进特性。（JEL D52, E43, E62, H20, H63）

articles.title_cn: “过早”去工业化的技术差距模型
articles.abstract_en: We propose a parsimonious mechanism for generating premature deindustrialization (PD). In the baseline model, the Baumol effect drives the hump-shaped path of the manufacturing share. Countries follow different paths due to the difference in the sector-specific adoption lags. The condition for PD under which countries differ only in technology gap implies that the cross-country productivity dispersion is the largest in agriculture. Moreover, when calibrated to match Rodrik’s (2016) findings, it is the smallest in manufacturing. In three extensions, we add the Engel effect, international trade, and catching up by late industrializers, to demonstrate the robustness of the mechanism. (JEL F11, L16, L60, O14, O33)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个生成过早去工业化（PD）的简约机制。在基准模型中，鲍莫尔效应驱动了制造业份额的驼峰形路径。由于部门特定采用滞后的差异，各国遵循不同的路径。PD的条件，即各国仅在技术差距上有所不同，意味着跨国生产率离散度在农业中最大。此外，当校准以匹配罗德里克（2016）的发现时，它在制造业中最小。在三个扩展中，我们加入了恩格尔效应、国际贸易和后期工业化国家的追赶，以证明该机制的稳健性。（JEL F11, L16, L60, O14, O33）

articles.title_en: Quality Is in the Eye of the Beholder: Taste Projection in Markets with Observational Learning
articles.title_cn: 质量在观察者眼中：具有观察学习的市场中的品味投射
articles.abstract_en: We study how misperceptions of others’ tastes influence beliefs, demand, and prices in markets with observational learning. Consumers infer a good’s quality from the quantity demanded and price paid by others. When consumers exaggerate the similarity between their and others’ tastes, such “taste projection” generates discrepant quality perceptions, which are decreasing in a projector’s taste and increasing in the observed price. These biased inferences produce an excessively elastic market demand. We also analyze dynamic monopoly pricing with short-lived taste-projecting consumers. Optimal pricing follows a declining path: a high initial price inflates future buyers’ perceptions, and lower subsequent prices induce overadoption. (JEL D42, D83, D91, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有观察学习的市场中，对他人口味的误解如何影响信念、需求和价格。消费者从他人购买的数量和支付的价格中推断商品的质量。当消费者夸大自己与他人品味之间的相似性时，这种“品味投射”会产生不一致的质量感知，这种感知随投射者的品味递减，随观察到的价格递增。这些有偏的推断导致市场需求过度弹性。我们还分析了短视的品味投射消费者下的动态垄断定价。最优定价遵循下降路径：高初始价格会抬高未来购买者的感知，而随后的较低价格会导致过度采用。（JEL D42, D83, D91, L15）
